newsitem.title: USA: Universal Hospital acts on cost-cutting.
newsitem.headline: Universal Hospital acts on cost-cutting.

text.p: Universal Hospital Services Inc said on Monday it implemented several expense control initiatives during the third quarter to reduce or defer costs.
President Thomas Minner said the benefit to the company of the short- and long-term cost reductions in 1997 is expected to be about $1 million for the full year, beginning with the first quarter.
Universal Hospital said the measures include the delay of two new office openings, executive salary costs and a moratorium on new hires.

"We eliminated 10 corporate positions during October by consolidating some functions and cutting other non-essential functions," Minner in a statement. "We also announced a shift in employee benefit from a total company-paid program to a shared cost program with our employees."
